transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this package review started. As you all know, we've got a 55-minute picture assembled with the draft title card and end credits, and the delivery folder currently has the stereo master, optional subtitle files, and a generic principal-credit block. I have authority to lock the episode package before it goes to the streaming distributor, but before I can do that, we need sign-off from standards, business affairs, and accessibility. Let's go through the checklist one by one -- each sign-off owner, please report your requirement and current status. We'll record any needed actions as commitments, and then we'll either lock or hold the package before we wrap today.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue before we proceed. I reviewed the distributor's regional standards memo this morning, and it confirms that this episode must be delivered at exactly 52 minutes -- not 55. The three-minute reduction must be taken from the second act. The memo is currently attached to my review queue rather than the delivery folder, which is why it hasn't been visible to the rest of you. Given this, I cannot sign off on standards until the runtime is corrected.

transcript.text: I need to flag a credit issue on my end. The agreement was signed after the generic credit block was created, and I have not yet updated the credit sheet to reflect this required format.
